description:
Yoga & Meditation Music | Sarangi & Tabla | Indian Classical

Some mornings the practice comes easy. Others you just need something to carry you into it.

This is 90 minutes of Sarangi and Tabla in Raga Bhairav — the classical Indian morning raga. Bhairav is slow and grounding. Its intervals are flat and serious in a way that doesn't feel heavy — more like the stillness before the day has fully begun. The Tabla keeps a gentle rhythm underneath, steady enough to move with, unhurried enough to breathe with.

You don't need to do anything specific with it. Play it during your yoga practice, your morning meditation, or just as the sound the morning sits in before everything else starts.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Sarangi — warm bowed strings, resonant and close
- Tabla — steady, gentle rhythm, yoga-appropriate tempo
- Raga Bhairav — the classical Indian morning raga, grounding and contemplative
- 432Hz tuning — slightly warmer than standard tuning
- 90 unbroken minutes — no interruptions

⏱ Chapters
0:00    Opening — settling in
20:00   Flow begins
45:00   Deep practice
70:00   Stillness
85:00   Gentle close

🧠 How to use:
Press play before you start. Let it set the pace. The Tabla gives you a rhythm to move with — not a strict beat, just a gentle pulse. The Sarangi holds the space between movements.

⏱ Best for:
• Morning yoga practice
• Seated morning meditation
• Pranayama and breathwork
• Gentle stretching or movement
• Calm weekend morning ritual

thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate warm-gold-and-saffron patterned border with morning lotus, sun-disc and dawn-bird motifs, aged warm parchment background, early morning palette (deep saffron fading to warm golden amber, soft dawn light filling the scene). Central figure: serene musician in saffron-and-cream attire seated cross-legged on a low woven mat playing sarangi (bowed instrument held upright against chest), tabla drums placed beside them in a quiet open courtyard at dawn. Soft golden morning light, a few early lotus blooms in the background. Expression of calm alertness — grounded, present, just beginning. Bold deep-teal serif overlay text reading 'MORNING FLOW' top-center, traditional Devanagari-influenced serif typography, high contrast for mobile readability. Warm saffron, golden amber, and aged cream palette, soft dawn mood, single composed scene, no clutter.
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Sarangi and Tabla in Raga Bhairav, morning yoga and meditation mood, warm bowed sarangi melody with steady gentle tabla rhythm underneath, 432Hz tuning, 75-85 BPM yoga-appropriate tempo — steady and grounded, not rushed, not too slow, comfortable to breathe and move with. Mid register sarangi (warm, resonant, not piercing), tabla at moderate dynamic (present but not dominant — it supports, it does not lead). Cinematic meditative production, grounding and contemplative feel, suitable for extended looping in post-production. Raga Bhairav — Sa Re(komal) Ga Ma Pa Dha(komal) Ni Sa. The flat 2nd and flat 6th give Bhairav its characteristic morning gravity. Emotionally: like the body waking up slowly and finding its own pace — not urgent, not sleepy, just present. IMPORTANT: Tabla must be steady and supportive — yoga rhythm, not performance rhythm. Alpha wave layer at -20dB subtle underneath.

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: Raga Bhairav — classical Indian morning raga. Sa Re(komal) Ga Ma Pa Dha(komal) Ni Sa. Komal Re and komal Dha give Bhairav its serious, grounding morning quality. Tabla must be steady and supportive — yoga tempo, not too fast.
